title: Re-test of every earlier strategy on the incoming Dukascopy and Databento data, with frozen parameters
registered: 2026-10-15, before the Dukascopy / Databento data arrived
rule: Parameters frozen exactly as in each original protocol. Each strategy is judged on data AFTER its original sample ended; that period is genuinely out of sample. No re-tuning on it. Earlier periods are reported, but only as a consistency check.
pass: fresh-period Sharpe > 0.5 after realistic costs (Dukascopy spreads by hour / CME fees + 1 tick) AND same sign as the original; candidates that pass go to the full Gen57-style robustness checks

dukascopy.Zarattini 2024 noise-area breakout (gen4: US100, US500; fresh period 2023-10..2026; also 1-min 2013-2020 as extra history

databento.F7/F9 futures trend + carry: fresh 2024-04..2026 on the CME subset; daily ranks c0-c2
databento.Noise-area breakout on NQ / ES: real futures, CME fees + 1 tick slippage, futures-firm intraday rules

new_strategies: Ideas never tested before use DEV = start..2022-12, TEST = 2023-01..end on all available data, each with its own protocol written before testing
trial_accounting: every re-test counts toward the project trial total and the deflated Sharpe
